blocks.text: Global powerhouse icons ATEEZ are set to make a highly anticipated return, dropping their explosive new pre-release single “Drip” from their upcoming album on October 23 at 1:00pm KST. The EP is out now via Sony Music Korea/RCA Records – click here to listen. The music video teaser for “Drip” released on October 20 has accumulated over 12 million views across all platforms. Following the massive success of “BAD,” ATEEZ is back to dominate with “Drip,” a track defined by its heavy trap rhythm.
